human.name: Perception
human.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

human.name: Mace Specialization
human.description: Mace and two-handed mace skill is increased by 5.

human.name: Sword Specialization
human.description: Passive. +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, auto attacks included, while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped. Read off Soda's Warrior tooltip.

human.name: Will to Survive
human.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.

dwarf.name: Stoneform
dwarf.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

dwarf.name: Find Treasure
dwarf.description: Sense nearby treasure and show it on the minimap. Lasts until cancelled.

dwarf.name: Mace Specialization
dwarf.description: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks while a mace or two-handed mace is equipped.

night-elf.name: Shadowmeld
night-elf.description: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Slip into the shadows until you move; Night Elf Rogues and Druids stealth as if 1 level higher. Usable in combat: enemies are discouraged from attacking you, but the cooldown becomes 2 min.

night-elf.name: Elune's Light
night-elf.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

gnome.name: Escape Artist
gnome.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Escape any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to them for 3 sec.

gnome.name: Eureka!
gnome.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Your next 3 damaging or healing abilities cost 50% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing.

orc.name: Blood Fury
orc.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

orc.name: Axe Specialization
orc.description: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities while an axe or two-handed axe is equipped.

orc.name: Command
orc.description: Damage dealt by Hunter and Warlock pets is increased by 5%.

orc.name: Shatter Curse
orc.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec.

undead.name: Will of the Forsaken
undead.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (No longer an immunity.)

undead.name: Cannibalize
undead.description: 5 yd, 2 min cooldown. Regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec from a Humanoid or Undead corpse; moving, acting or taking damage cancels it.

undead.name: Touch of the Grave
undead.description: Your spells and attacks have a 5% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

tauren.name: War Stomp
tauren.description: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

tauren.name: Plainsrunning
tauren.description: Gain increased movement speed the longer you keep moving.

troll.name: Berserking
troll.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

troll.name: Regeneration
troll.description: 10% of Health regen continues in combat.

troll.name: Throwing Specialization
troll.description: Throwing weapon skill is increased by 5.

troll.name: Rapid Regeneration
troll.description: Channeled, 3 min cooldown. Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec; any movement, action or damage taken cancels it.

skyborne-horde.name: Walk on Air
skyborne-horde.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

skyborne-horde.name: Skysight
skyborne-horde.description: 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Draw power from a convergence of elements: +10% movement and mounted speed for 30 sec, or 15 min if a convergence is nearby.

skyborne-horde.name: Wind Blessed
skyborne-horde.description: 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.

skyborne-alliance.name: Walk on Air
skyborne-alliance.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

skyborne-alliance.name: Read Ley Line
skyborne-alliance.description: 2 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Tap a nearby ley line for +100% Health and Mana regeneration: 15 sec if no ley line is nearby, 15 min if one is found.

skyborne-alliance.name: Wind Blessed
skyborne-alliance.description: 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.
